testCase:
R-48: Show me the comparison of the first two personal credit cards that do not charge foreign transaction fees.
Goal: Show me the comparison of the first two personal credit cards that do not charge foreign transaction fees.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-48/
STEP 2: Hover over "Credit cards"
STEP 3: Click "All credit cards"
STEP 4: Check "No foreign transaction fee"
STEP 5: Check "Compare Cedar Voyager"
STEP 6: Check "Compare Cedar Globetrotter"
STEP 7: Click "Compare selected (2)"
STEP 8: Verify "Comparing: Cedar Voyager and Cedar Globetrotter" is visible

steps.note: Open the credit card test page.
Reveal the credit cards navigation menu.
Filter for cards without foreign transaction fees.
Select the first specified card for comparison.
Select the second specified card for comparison.

args.text: Comparing: Cedar Voyager and Cedar Globetrotter

steps.note: Verify the comparison shows the requested pair.

reasoning: This tests displaying a comparison of the first two personal credit cards with no foreign transaction fees. The plan follows the specified filter and card selections, then checks the exact comparison text.
